title: Straylight Production
description: Production health for the simplified agent workspace plus retained legacy and asset operations. The first group is the owner view for open, search, write, indexing, and usage-tracking symptoms. Metrics are content-free and use bounded dimensions only. Source: infra/datadog/straylight-production-dashboard.json.

definition.content: Use **env**, **version**, and **component** to isolate a rollout. Start with **00 Simplified Workspace**: it exposes the slow-open and broad-search symptoms that matter to the owner, then worker progress and dependencies. Metric tags never contain user IDs, record IDs, paths, queries, or source content.

This is the primary owner view for the simplified Markdown and binary workspace. A healthy open should remain comfortably below seconds, broad `/workspace/search` calls should stay bounded, and one failed retrieval lane should degrade rather than stall the whole request. **Current gap:** the API does not emit simple queue depth or oldest-job age; the worker panels therefore show processed work and retry/failure transitions, not backlog.
